The aggregate gross proceeds from the offering, before deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and other offering expenses, were approximately $93. 5 billion, of which approximately $91. 6 billion was received by Anthropic.

item.title: TAI #230: Claude Helps Prove the Riemann Hypothesis as Gemini 4 Neon Overtakes Carbon
item.guid: title:tai 230 claude helps prove the riemann hypothesis as gemini 4 neon overtakes carbon
item.description: Also, Inkling 2 Mini, Jensen Returns, Anthropic IPO, and more. What happened this week in AI by Louie Eight days after Google opened Gemini 4 Carbon to developers, Gemini 4 Neon was already beating it on coding tests. Gemini is firmly back in the game. This week also brought a huge moment for AI. For years, many people dismissed LLMs as stochastic parrots that could only repeat what they had seen in their training data. On Friday, Anthropic mathematician Levent Alpöge announced that he and Claude had proved the Riemann hypothesis together, a problem mathematicians had been trying to solve since 1859 and arguably one of the hardest open problems in mathematics.
